name: Mirabell Bell
source:
Faction: US Forces
Skill: Powered Exoskeleton (Beru Senyouki), New Model of the US Forces "Centurion" (Beiren no Shingata "Senchurion")
Artist: [url=/s3451]OV[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/81bfe42d0aaef922da01c38265268554.png]US 5 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/df5d98c5464eb23a0eb855e7ea448a1f.jpeg]US 5 Stars EX[/url]
History:
She is a hardened Soldier, known to fight very tactical and being a great commander. Known to deeply care for her team, she will sacrifice herself for them if needed. Having mostly a stern look, she can be shy about sexual manners.
Mirabell is polite and self controlled towards those above her, and remains calm in combat. She enjoys the XPS-11A Bone suits and even feels some form of nostalgia towards them, even if they are sooner or later outclassed. 
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Mirabell_Bell]breezewiki.com[/url]]
